title: Run Diagnostics (didSave)
summary: Runs drag-lint's diagnostics pass on a file automatically when it is saved, mirroring the LSP textDocument/didSave notification
intro: Read this to know why drag-lint findings refresh on their own: with automatic diagnostics on, the pass runs on a file each time you save it in the IDE. You can also trigger it by hand for the active editor with Ctrl+Alt+D or the About dialog button.

surfaces.caption: Run Diagnostics (didSave)
steps: It fires on every save when Run diagnostics automatically on save is enabled in the options
To run it by hand on the active editor: press Ctrl+Alt+D or click Run Diagnostics (didSave) in the About dialog
It needs an open editor with a saved file
There is no CLI equivalent; it runs in-process in the plugin

questions.ask: Why do drag-lint findings refresh by themselves when I save?
